allowed: package the exact target and its unmodified dependency closure
add declarations, typedefs, macros, or a lossless name-forwarding shim required by the documented input format
allocate fixed backing storage and constrain correlated lengths or indices to the original API contract
NUL-terminate otherwise artifact-generated bytes before passing them as C strings
forbidden_for_scoring: patch baseline analysis, generation, comparison, search, or runtime logic
change target arity or return type to evade a released emitter failure
bundle scalar arguments solely to evade a released emitter failure
replace semantically relevant target or dependency logic
encode a previously known defect witness
policy.failure_rule: If the released baseline fails on the original interface after allowed input packaging, retain compile_failure or analysis_failure. A later workaround is exploratory_unscored.
